name: Bot Builder
tagline: Turns a fuzzy bot idea into a paste-ready spec for one bot or a crew
description: Start with something as vague as needing a bot for invoices and it returns a production-grade specification to paste straight into Grok, whether a single operator or a crew with divided roles. Anything material is held for sign-off before it locks, so the spec cannot drift from what you asked for.
author: brodyis4doge
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
